messages:
Lina Q: RelayMetrics sent a renewal quote but their invoice differs from the spreadsheet. dropping here for finance/procurement review. headline: 1.2M committed tokens/mo @ $17/1M, $27 overage, $2k onboarding, prefers monthly invoices. link: https://vendor-quotes.internal/relaymetrics/21155
Mark (Fin): what's the discrepancy? paste the invoice lines. need per-1M number for GL and whether VAT applies.
Lina Q: invoice snippet they sent via email:
INV-21155,2026-07-01,2026-07-31,committed_tokens,1200000,20,24.00
INV-21155,2026-07-01,2026-07-31,overage_tokens,100000,27,2.70
INV-21155,2026-07-01,2026-07-31,onboarding_fee,1,2000,2000.00
Their quote PDF showed $17/1M but invoice line uses $20/1M.
Mark (Fin): not good. ask for corrected invoice and why price changed. also confirm billing entity and whether they accept PO/net-30. finance will hold approval until corrected invoice + W-9 and SOC2/DPA. cap for finance-only pilots: $100k TCV.
Arjun (Procure): will ask vendor to reissue invoice and confirm PO acceptance. negotiation ask: get onboarding credited and lock $17/1M for 6 months pilot. propose 3-mo pilot with 30-day opt-out.
billing-bot: Reminder — open PR in procurement before legal review: /po create <vendor> <amount> <budget-code>.
Lina Q: emailed vendor: "Please reissue invoice at quoted $17/1M or explain variance. Also confirm PO/net-30, billing entity, SOC2, and ability to include hashed_request_id in exports for reconciliation."
Mark (Fin): if they refuse to correct invoice, finance will escalate to legal. if they reissue and accept PO/net-30 and credit onboarding, we can approve up to $90k TCV for a 3-month pilot.
Arjun (Procure): created draft PR-2026-713. Lina, paste vendor reply here when you get it and I'll finalize PO.
Lina Q: vendor replied: apologized, said invoice was generated with list price by mistake, will reissue at $17/1M and waive onboarding for a 3-month pilot if we accept PO/net-30. sending SOC2 summary this afternoon.
Mark (Fin): good. upload SOC2 + W-9 to PR and Finance will sign PO once invoice reissued. keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
